name: rendr
description: Record, edit and direct film with Rendr from Claude Desktop.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to the MCP server inside Rendr Agentic Cinema, an open-source app that records, edits and generates video in one place. All 102 declared tools are implemented: capture sources and recording, the cursor-driven zoom punch-ins, and the full editing surface — clips, transitions, captions, colour, keyframes, audio and export. The node graph that casts and shoots a film is driven from the same surface, so a shot it renders lands as a clip these tools can trim.
